key_concepts: Earth has two distinct motions: rotation and revolution
Rotation is the spinning of Earth on its axis
Earth rotates from west to east or counterclockwise
One rotation takes about 24 hours, specifically 23 hours and 56 minutes
The apparent east-to-west movement of the Sun is caused by Earth's rotation
Revolution is Earth's movement around the Sun
Earth revolves around the Sun in an elliptical orbit
Earth rotates on its axis as it revolves around the Sun
Earth's axis is the imaginary line through which it spins
Earth's orbit is the imaginary path around the Sun
